name: Okuwamon
main_effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a card with the [Insectoid] trait, all of your opponent's Digimon gain "[All Turns] When this Digimon becomes suspended, lose 1 memory." until the end of your opponent's turn.
source_effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has the [Insectoid] trait, it gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.).
